title: Vuber Pulse 510 Drop Battery
description:
VUBER PULSE AND VUBER PULSE TOUCH ALSO AVAILABLE

Designed to be part of your everyday life, the Pulse Drop packs the punch you need for cartridges. Drop your cartridge in, inhale, and let the Drop take your cartridge to new heights! Featuring Vuber’s patented “Never Burn” technology, the Drop will select the appropriate voltage for your cartridge based on the resistance of the cart and taper down the voltage as you inhale!

Product Features:
– Product Measurements: 1.9″ H x 2.10″ W x 0.85″ D
– Product Weight: 2 oz
– Battery Capacity: 400 mAh
– Charging Method: USB-C (cable included)
– “Never Burn” technology, tapers the heat as you draw, which allows you to attach any cartridge and be certain you will have the best flavour to vapor experience.
– Reads the resistance of the cartridge and automatically adjusts the settings for optimal use.
– Suction-activated vapor on demand
– Two attachment points for necklace, lanyard, keychain, or other attachments
– 400mAh battery allows for long uses between charging
– Pass-through USB-C charging lets you use the device even when plugged in to charge
